dbo.name: vector_document
dbo.description: Source documents and media assets managed by the vector pipeline.

schema.name: title
schema.description: Human-readable title or filename for the document.

schema.name: content
schema.description: Raw textual content of the document.

schema.name: media_data
schema.description: Base64-encoded media data for multimodal documents (image, audio, video).

schema.name: mime_type
schema.description: MIME type (e.g. text/markdown, image/png, image/jpeg, audio/mp3, video/mp4).

schema.name: metadata
schema.description: Arbitrary structured metadata (tags, author, source URL, dimensions, etc.).

schema.name: status
schema.description: Current indexing lifecycle status: pending, indexing, indexed, or failed.

schema.name: chunk_count
schema.description: Total number of vector chunks generated from this document.

schema.name: strategy
schema.description: Chunking strategy used during indexing.

schema.name: chunk_size
schema.description: Target character chunk size used during indexing.

schema.name: chunk_overlap
schema.description: Chunk character overlap used during indexing.

schema.name: error_message
schema.description: Error description if status is failed.

schema.name: user_id
schema.description: The user who owns or uploaded this document.

dbo.name: vector_chunk
dbo.description: Document chunks and multimodal embeddings for semantic vector search.

schema.name: document_id
schema.description: The document this chunk was generated from.

schema.name: chunk_index
schema.description: 0-based sequence index of the chunk within the document.

schema.name: content
schema.description: The text content or caption of this chunk.

schema.name: media_data
schema.description: Base64 media data if this chunk is a multimodal asset.

schema.name: mime_type
schema.description: MIME type of the chunk content (e.g. text/plain, image/png, audio/mp3).

schema.name: embedding
schema.description: Google Gemini 768-dimensional multimodal vector embedding.

schema.name: metadata
schema.description: Metadata specific to this chunk (e.g. section title, timestamps, bounding box).

schema.name: char_count
schema.description: Character length of the text content.

function.name: vector/generate_embedding
function.description: Generates a 768-dimensional multimodal vector embedding for text, images, audio, or video using Google Gemini Embeddings 2.

input.name: text
input.description: Text content to generate a vector embedding for.

input.name: media_data
input.description: Base64-encoded media data (image, audio, or video bytes).

input.name: mime_type
input.description: MIME type for media data (e.g. image/png, image/jpeg, audio/mp3, video/mp4).

input.name: model
input.description: Google Gemini embedding model name (default: gemini-embedding-2).

input.name: api_key
input.description: Optional Google API key override. If omitted, uses the configured environment variable.

error.value: generate_embedding: at least one of `text` or `media_data` must be provided.
generate_embedding: missing Gemini API key. Set `CUSTOM_GEMINI_KEY` in your environment or pass `api_key` explicitly.

input.name: code

function.name: vector/chunk_text
function.description: Segments input text into structured chunks based on the chosen strategy (fixed, paragraph, sentence, markdown, custom).

input.name: content
input.description: The raw text content to segment into chunks.

input.name: strategy
input.description: Chunking algorithm: fixed, paragraph, sentence, markdown, or custom.

input.name: chunk_size
input.description: Target maximum character count per chunk.

input.name: chunk_overlap
input.description: Character overlap preserved between consecutive chunks.

input.name: code

function.name: vector/ingest_document
function.description: Fetches a document/media record, chunks text (or processes media), generates Gemini embeddings, and saves chunks.

input.name: document_id
input.description: The primary key ID of the document to ingest and index.

input.name: api_key
input.description: Optional Google API key override.

function.name: vector/search_vectors
function.description: Performs semantic similarity search over document chunks using Gemini 768-dim embeddings and pgvector.

input.name: query
input.description: Natural language query string. If provided, embedded via Gemini.

input.name: query_media_data
input.description: Base64-encoded media data for visual/audio/multimodal search queries.

input.name: query_mime_type
input.description: MIME type for query media data (e.g. image/png, audio/mp3).

input.name: query_embedding
input.description: Pre-computed 768-dimensional query vector embedding.

input.name: limit
input.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

input.name: threshold
input.description: Minimum cosine similarity score threshold (0.0 to 1.0).

input.name: api_key
input.description: Optional Google API key override.

error.value: search_vectors: either `query` text, `query_media_data`, or `query_embedding` vector must be provided.

query.name: vec/documents/create
query.description: Create a new document or media asset and immediately chunk and index it.

input.name: title
input.description: Title or filename for the document.

input.name: content
input.description: Raw text content of the document.

input.name: media_data
input.description: Base64-encoded media data (images, audio, video).

input.name: mime_type
input.description: MIME type (e.g. text/markdown, image/png, audio/mp3).

input.name: metadata
input.description: Arbitrary structured metadata.

input.name: strategy
input.description: Chunking algorithm for text content.

input.name: chunk_size
input.description: Target maximum chunk size in characters.

input.name: chunk_overlap
input.description: Chunk character overlap.

error.value: create_document: either `content` text or `media_data` must be provided.

query.name: vec/documents
query.description: List uploaded documents and media assets with pagination.

input.name: page
input.description: Page number (1-based).

input.name: per_page
input.description: Number of documents per page.

query.name: vec/documents/{id}
query.description: Get a specific document record along with all its vector chunks.

input.name: id
input.description: Document ID.

query.name: vec/documents/{id}/delete
query.description: Delete a document and all of its associated vector chunks.

input.name: id
input.description: Document ID to delete.

query.name: vec/documents/{id}/reindex
query.description: Re-chunk and re-embed an existing document with updated chunking parameters.

input.name: id
input.description: Document ID to reindex.

input.name: strategy
input.description: New chunking algorithm (fixed, paragraph, sentence, markdown, custom).

input.name: chunk_size
input.description: Updated target chunk size.

input.name: chunk_overlap
input.description: Updated chunk overlap.

query.name: vec/search
query.description: Search document chunks and media using semantic similarity via 768-dim Gemini vector embeddings.

input.name: query
input.description: Natural language query string.

input.name: query_media_data
input.description: Base64-encoded media data for visual/audio search queries.

input.name: query_mime_type
input.description: MIME type for media data if provided.

input.name: query_embedding
input.description: Pre-computed 768-dimensional query vector.

input.name: limit
input.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

input.name: threshold
input.description: Minimum similarity threshold (0.0 to 1.0).

query.name: vec/embed
query.description: Directly generates a 768-dimensional vector embedding for text or media using Google Gemini API.

input.name: text
input.description: Text content to generate an embedding vector for.

input.name: media_data
input.description: Base64 media data (image, audio, video).

input.name: mime_type
input.description: MIME type for media data if provided.

input.name: model
input.description: Google Gemini embedding model name.

tool.name: vector_search
tool.description: Search the indexed document and media knowledge base using semantic vector similarity with Gemini multimodal embeddings.
tool.instructions: Use this tool to search and retrieve facts, documentation, notes, specifications, images, and media files from the user's knowledge base to answer questions.

input.name: query
input.description: Natural language search query to locate relevant context or media.

input.name: media_data
input.description: Optional base64 media data for visual/audio search queries.

input.name: mime_type
input.description: MIME type for media data if provided (e.g. image/png, audio/mp3).

input.name: limit
input.description: Maximum number of relevant chunks to retrieve (default: 5).

app.name: Vector
app.description: Vector embedding pipeline, document ingestion, and similarity search endpoints.
